title: Pick the right calibration code among near-miss codes
rationale: Near-identical codes differing by one character invite transcription errors; a wrong calibration code can mask axle faults on rail stock.

notes: Deterministic: fully synthetic static filler (7331 chars), temperature 0, repeats 1, a single mechanical pass condition. Candidate lines sit at about 20, 44, 63 and 80 percent of the log; only the master-register code passes. Brittleness: answering with any other LATTICE or KATTICE code fails.
